title: Perp momentum
description: How the perpetual's mark price has moved over the last one, five and fifteen minutes. Leverage often moves ahead of spot.

return_bps_1m.label: Return 1m
return_bps_1m.description: The change in mark price over the last minute, in basis points. Positive means the perp has been rising.

return_bps_5m.label: Return 5m
return_bps_5m.description: The change in mark price over the last five minutes, in basis points. The window most fifteen-minute rounds care about.

return_bps_15m.label: Return 15m
return_bps_15m.description: The change in mark price over the last fifteen minutes, in basis points. The slow trend behind the shorter reads.

direction_5m.label: Move direction 5m
direction_5m.description: Up or down once the five-minute return clears a small threshold, otherwise flat. The one-word version of the return.
